linesVerbatim: ## D-032 — DR-105 / DR-114 actor scope (Option B + measured tails)
- **Status:** **ADOPTED 2026-08-13.** Turn 3 of 3: zero MUST-FIX from
either reviewer. Claude 2 SHOULD-FIX (BLK-6 write token) and Codex
SHOULD-FIX (catalog + CA-3 routes) accepted into these bytes.
- **Decision type:** PREFERENCE-LADEN.
- **Subject:** whether host surfaces under the user's direct
instruction are subject to DR-105 component permissions.
- **Decision:** Host-under-instruction is outside DR-105 (fourth
deliberate non-token). Doctor consent is a doctor-side
invocation-bound record, not a grant. Component tails (CA-1 spawn,
component CA-4 egress) stay in DR-105. Host-actor owners:
Operability + security jointly with Security + platform owners. A
scoped host-effect authorization contract is **necessary, not
sufficient**, before CA-1 host head, CA-2, CA-3, or host CA-4 is
exercisable; until then fail-closed. That contract's mandatory
minimum includes typed host outcomes: completed,
definitely-not-performed, unknown/indeterminate (BLK-3 stays
STILL-ROUTED, not discharged). CA-2 also needs DR-119 (and
DR-117/128 if third-party). CA-3: out-of-root read, local
socket/pipe, privileged facility → host-effect contract;
keychain → DR-108, still deferred, unexercisable. `permissionRef`
permanently reserved. Slice-1 doctor egress execution side remains
for that contract. Join blockers: BLK-1/2/3/4 STILL-ROUTED as
above; BLK-5 DISCHARGED; BLK-6 DISCHARGED-AS-INAPPLICABLE for host
default **reads and** doctor's operational-metadata write
(FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE is not a component grant; fail-closed if that
class is denied); BLK-7 REPAIRED-IN-V4. Applies no candidate.
- **Readiness effect:** Zero. No SATISFIED. No blueprint.
- **Reversibility:** total before conforming successors; then also
their owning-authority supersession. **Commit:** C-D032.

extractedDecidedClauses.standing: EXTRACTED from adopted D-032 unless a clause names a different source. Not re-decided here. Clauses marked NAMED from recorded host-effect are environment from the D-093/D-126 candidates, not D-032 extraction and not FC-C1.
extractedDecidedClauses.doctorConsent: A doctor-side invocation-bound record, not a grant.
extractedDecidedClauses.componentTails: After a host CA-1 SPAWN decision has produced an admitted component child, EVERY subsequent effect of that admitted child stays in DR-105. Egress of that child is typed specifically as DR-105 / PT-NET-EGRESS and is not doctor CA-4 and not host CA-4. Representative non-egress admitted-child DR-105 routes include PT-FS-READ-PROJECT, PT-FS-READ-COMPONENT, PT-FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE, PT-PROC-EXEC-DECLARED, PT-ENV-READ, and PT-HOST-EFFECT-BROKERED. The list is representative and non-exhaustive under the EVERY-effect rule. PT-FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE is the recorded component permission token for an admitted child's write into its allocated host-owned state namespace; it is not doctor's operational-metadata write. Doctor's own unprefixed FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE operational-metadata write remains BLK-6 DISCHARGED-AS-INAPPLICABLE and is not a component grant (see hostDefaultReadsAndOperationalMetadataWrite). The host CA-1 SPAWN decision is excluded from that tail. The v2/v3 phrase 'component-originated CA-4 egress' is superseded by this typed PT-NET-EGRESS correction.
extractedDecidedClauses.hostActorOwnersNamed: Operability+security jointly with Security+platform. Naming them here is extraction, not a new grant and not a D-096 (A) mint.
extractedDecidedClauses.hostEffectNecessaryNotSufficient: A scoped host-effect authorization contract is necessary, not sufficient, before the CA-1-host-head class, CA-2, CA-3, or host CA-4 is exercisable. Necessity does not make CA-1 IN_PROCESS or CA-2 exercisable; those remain preview-unexercisable per recorded host-effect v8/v25.
extractedDecidedClauses.failClosedUntilRecorded: Until the joint owners record that contract, fail-closed. File existence, ACCEPT, and coordinator leftover recording are not that recording (FC-C1).
extractedDecidedClauses.mandatoryHostOutcomes: completed, definitely-not-performed, unknown/indeterminate. BLK-3 stays STILL-ROUTED.
extractedDecidedClauses.ca2: EXTRACTED from D-032: a CA-2 process-creation decision is host-side and outside DR-105; CA-2 also needs DR-119 (and DR-117/128 if third-party). NAMED from recorded host-effect v8/v25, not extracted from D-032: the customer tool's later effects are neither admitted-component PT-NET-EGRESS nor host CA-4; DR-119 is necessary and not sufficient; a later D-000 product/authorization decision — product owner of DR-119 jointly with Security+platform — is a separate necessary gate. CA-2 remains wholly unexercisable until both gates exist, plus DR-117/128 if third-party. Naming that later D-000 decision is not minting it and is not a D-096 (A) grant.
extractedDecidedClauses.ca3: Out-of-root read, local socket/pipe, privileged facility ride the host-effect contract. Keychain rides DR-108, still deferred, unexercisable.
extractedDecidedClauses.slice1DoctorEgress: Execution side remains for the host-effect contract.

joinBlockers.BLK-6: DISCHARGED-AS-INAPPLICABLE for host default reads and doctor's operational-metadata write (FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE is not a component grant; fail-closed if that class is denied)

extractedDecidedClauses.hostSideAttemptsOutsideDr105: Consentable host-side attempts outside DR-105, scoped exactly to five members: CA-1 SPAWN decision, CA-1 IN_PROCESS attempt, CA-2 process-creation decision, CA-3, and CA-4-HOST. Membership on this roster is not a uniform gate. CA-1 SPAWN, non-keychain CA-3, and CA-4-HOST require the host-effect contract (necessary, not sufficient) and remain fail-closed until FC-C1. CA-1 IN_PROCESS remains UNEXERCISABLE in the architecture preview even when FC-C1 is recorded. CA-2 remains wholly unexercisable (DR-119 necessary not sufficient; later D-000 gate named from recorded host-effect, not minted).
extractedDecidedClauses.hostDefaultReadsAndOperationalMetadataWr: EXTRACTED from D-032 BLK-6 DISCHARGED-AS-INAPPLICABLE: host default reads and doctor's operational-metadata write (FS-WRITE-HOST-STATE is not a component grant). These are not members of the consentable CA-1..CA-4 roster. They are not DR-105 component grants. Fail-closed if the applicable host class is denied. BLK-6 is not reopened. No token is minted.
extractedDecidedClauses.inheritedPermissionRecitalConflict: Permission-truth-tables v2/v6 recitals that treat CA-1/CA-2 together as producing an admitted-component PT-NET-EGRESS tail were an inherited conflict. Recorded permission-truth-tables.v9 / D-128 resolves that recital: CA-2 customer-tool later effects stay off the token. This leftover-integration names that environment and does not apply v9. v2 and v6 remain unapplied.
extractedDecidedClauses.hostHeadTermBinding: One binding governs this artifact. 'CA-1-host-head' is the recorded host-effect covered-act class with two classified subtypes: SPAWN and IN_PROCESS. 'Host head' used without a subtype means that class. 'CA-1 SPAWN decision' is the SPAWN subtype only and is the only CA-1 subtype that can become exercisable under the host-effect contract's other gates. 'CA-1 IN_PROCESS attempt' is the IN_PROCESS subtype only. This artifact never uses 'host head' as a synonym for SPAWN alone.
extractedDecidedClauses.ca1InProcess: NAMED from recorded host-effect v8 and v25, not extracted from D-032. CA-1 IN_PROCESS is classified and UNEXERCISABLE in the architecture preview. It cannot be relabeled as SPAWN. It remains denied even when FC-C1 is recorded and the host-effect contract is otherwise sufficient. This artifact does not admit the subtype. D-093 and D-126 leftover recordings are not FC-C1 and do not make IN_PROCESS exercisable.
